run_profiler_context: use maybe_run_profiler as a context manager to profile a PyTorch module with xformers and wandb integration
convert_perfetto_to_html: convert a perfetto trace JSON file to an interactive HTML viewer using perfetto_to_html
configure_profiler_args: create a ProfilerArgs dataclass to configure warmup steps, profile steps, and trace folder for profiling
profile_with_wandb_pytorch: use PyTorchProfilerWandb to profile PyTorch operations and log trace HTML artifacts to wandb
profile_memory_with_wandb: use MemSnapshotsProfilerWandb to capture memory snapshots and log memory trace plots to wandb
